_story_card: story_card.gd: the card that stands beside a watched story's person or town once the camera lands (CK3's event toast), and stays while the camera is there: width points wide; it waits wait_land seconds for the camera to land, else it isn't shown; person_radius and town_radius (world units) keep it clear of what it stands by; waits and news are its line when the story waits on the King at court, or doesn't. Closed, a story still going on leaves its mark over its place, which opens it again.
_loading: intro.gd _is_ready: once the realm stands, the loading card stays until every frame has kept steady_fps for steady_s seconds (so play starts smooth), or most_s seconds have passed since it stood.
_smooth_scale: main.gd apply_graphics: Smooth draws the 3D world at this share of the window's pixels a side (0.47: about half the pixels of the project's 0.67), MetalFX upscaling it to full size; the interface is always drawn sharp. Beautiful keeps project.godot scaling_3d/scale.
_: The interface's finesse pass (docs/review/ui-pass.md; ui.gd reads it through data.gd). The camera pad shows only when the player picks 'always' in Settings (else the camera moves by mouse, trackpad and keys) and the minimap sits flush to the right edge; the date card is capped at top.maxWidth points, its long lines ending in an ellipsis; the chronicle drawer is chronicle.width points wide and at most chronicle.height of the screen tall; a town card not pinned by its town stands on the left, townCard.width points wide; a toast is toast.width points wide.

chronicle._: chronicle_panel.gd: the drawer down the right is the one place for the news and its answers (Mac: click the news, the camera pans, the chronicle opens with its action buttons). width in points; height a share of the screen; rows kept; here: the words over the answers of the line the camera went to.

next._: top_bar.gd: the next line (bridge next.js) stays quiet for these kinds: the ladder's step is the objective's own line, the court's sitting is its badge (Mac: 'I should know what the hell to do'; one thing to do at a time).

close._: ui.gd close_x: the one close X on a card (town, house, court; CK3's and Total War's panel close): its square box's size, its inset from the card's top and right edges (the same both ways; Mac: 'this is not centered'), the X's width (centred in the box), and the least corner radius of its hover box, which is otherwise the card's own less the inset (concentric with the card's corner).

counsel._: top_bar.gd _show_next: the counsel (bridge next.js) is a notice that comes and goes, not a line on the date card (Mac: the top-left stacked six things). A new word is told at most every gap seconds; the same word is told again after again seconds while it still stands.

tips.host: Selects your host and shows it to you.
tips.nowhere: Nowhere to go yet: it shows when the moment comes.

step._: top_bar.gd: the one step he is on, as a button under the goal (Anno 1800's quest tracker). do: what each objective's step buttons do, in order (host: select his host; place: go to the objective's town); a step not named goes to the place. go: the button for an objective with a place and no steps. tips: the button's tooltip, by what it does.

act._: top_bar.gd _tell_act: the reign's story's act is told as a notice when it begins (not kept on the date card), with the King's next promise still to keep.
